name: Bizuno Accounting – Powerful ERP & Accounting for WordPress
author: phreesoft

sections.description:
Bizuno Accounting by PhreeSoft is your all-in-one ERP powerhouse, transforming WordPress into a robust business management hub. As the modern evolution of PhreeBooks, Bizuno delivers lightning-fast performance, ironclad security, and unmatched customization to supercharge your operations.

Say goodbye to fragmented tools and hello to streamlined workflows! Whether you’re a small business owner, e-commerce seller, or growing enterprise, Bizuno empowers you with professional-grade accounting, inventory, CRM, and more – all without the hefty price tag.

Game-Changing Features to Elevate Your Business

  • True Double-Entry Accounting: Rock-solid financials with general ledger, AR/AP, bank reconciliation, and multi-currency support for global operations.
  • Advanced Inventory Management: Track stock levels, serial/lot numbers, assemblies/BOMs, and multi-warehouse setups. Sync seamlessly with WooCommerce for real-time inventory control!
  • Customer & Vendor Mastery: Manage contacts, quotes, orders, invoices, and payments with ease. Add custom fields and tabs for tailored CRM.
  • Multi-Store Support: Effortlessly handle multiple stores or locations within one system – perfect for expanding businesses.
  • US Sales Tax Calculator: Accurate, automated sales tax handling powered by PhreeSoft’s RESTful API (US-only) – compliance made simple!
  • Integrated Shipping Excellence: Connect with top carriers like USPS, FedEx, and UPS for real-time quotes, label generation, and freight bill reconciliation. Save time and reduce errors!
  • Quality Management for ISO 9001: Streamline your certification process with built-in tools for process tracking, audits, and compliance reporting – achieve and maintain ISO 9001 with less hassle.
  • Powerful Reporting & Forms: 50+ ready-to-use reports plus the drag-and-drop PhreeForm builder for custom invoices, statements, and analytics.
  • Customizable Dashboards: Per-menu, user-configurable dashboards with 80+ widgets – get instant insights at a glance.
  • User-Centric Design: Responsive UI for desktop/mobile/tablet, multi-language support, role-based security, and personalized themes/icons/colors.
  • Extensible & Integrated: Plug in modules for payments (Stripe, PayFabric), marketplaces, and more. Premium WooCommerce sync for orders, customers, and inventory.
  • Secure & Scalable: Multi-user roles, RESTful APIs, and flexible deployment – standalone, WordPress plugin, or cloud-hosted.

Why Choose Bizuno? Boost productivity, cut costs, and scale effortlessly. Trusted by businesses worldwide since evolving from PhreeBooks in 2007. Open-source freedom with enterprise-level power!

sections.installation:
Get Started in Minutes – No Coding Required!

  1. Install & activate via WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Navigate to the Bizuno menu in your WP admin.
  3. Click the prominent Install button on the welcome portal.
  4. Breeze through the quick 4-step setup wizard.
  5. Boom! Your customized Bizuno dashboard loads in seconds, ready to revolutionize your business.
sections.faq:
How does Bizuno help with ISO 9001 certification?

Bizuno’s quality-focused features like inventory tracking, customizable reports, ticket manager and audit trails streamline documentation and processes, making ISO 9001 compliance faster and easier to maintain.

Does it support multi-store operations?

Absolutely! Manage multiple stores or warehouses seamlessly within one Bizuno instance – ideal for multi-location businesses.

Tell me about the sales tax feature.

Our US-only sales tax calculator uses real-time data via PhreeSoft’s API for accurate calculations, ensuring compliance without manual headaches.

What about shipping integrations?

Integrated with USPS, FedEx, and UPS for real-time rate quoting, easy label printing, and automated freight bill reconciliation – optimize your logistics!

Which chart of accounts should I pick?

Start with one of our standard charts during install. Customize freely post-setup or import your current chart of accounts, just remember if you wish to replace your chart completely, do so before your first journal entry.

Where’s the full Bizuno code?

Since v7.3+, this plugin acts as a secure portal. The comprehensive Bizuno app downloads automatically during installation for optimal security and updates via the standard WordPress plugin management tool.
